explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/275 (Selfridge; Crittenden–Vanden Eynden): r congruences covering 2^r consecutive integers cover all of ℤ. Moduli n_i = 0 are allowed, where a congruence mod 0 is a single point. That slight generalisation does not appear to break the statement, since a singleton covers too little, and a formal proof of exactly this statement is linked.
